says: Alice binds her device key, authors a personal Instructions source whose revision the owner returns with the body digest it computed, and selects that exact revision in her personal Instructions position. She opens a recipient link to the conversation her work is in, and composes a preparation bound to that link: one winning unit whose body is the revision's member. Delivering that preparation's body to the current recipient on that link returns an attempt that received exactly that body, and observing the preparation returns an inventory naming the unit, source, revision and body that arrived for that recipient. Three negatives follow, none of which may claim a delivery: the same bodies sent on a second link she opened for another conversation are refused as recipient_mismatch, because the preparation names its recipient; an attempt naming a link id the runtime never issued is refused as recipient_link_unknown and sees no channel; and a rehydrated recipient offered only the body's hash is refused as rehydration_needs_bodies. After them the observation of the preparation is unchanged: no refused attempt added a body, a recipient or a second delivery.
